visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of young children, mostly boys in suits and girls in white dresses, stand on a brightly lit stage. A central boy in a white shirt and black tie holds a glowing yellow star wand. The background is a blue banner with traditional Chinese text and colorful ball decorations. (2) Close-up of a newborn baby wrapped in a white swaddle, lying on a green patterned cushion. The baby has dark hair and eyes open, looking slightly to the side. (3) A slightly older infant in a blue Captain America shirt sits in a stroller. He is laughing heartily, showing toothless gums, while wearing a Mickey Mouse patterned bib. (4) A young boy wears a blue school uniform and a red Santa hat with a small Christmas tree on top. He looks down at a set of red handbells in his hands, appearing shy. (5) The boy, still in his school uniform and Santa hat, sits on the lap of a person dressed as Santa Claus. A woman in a mask adjusts his clothes. He maintains a downcast, shy expression. (6) On a stage with blue curtains, the boy wears a large black curly wig and a red scarf over his school uniform. He stands still with a serious, slightly nervous look. (7) Back to the graduation stage, the boy in the white shirt and tie sings enthusiastically with his mouth wide open, still holding the star wand. (8) The boy, dressed in a brown squirrel costume with a fluffy tail, performs in a stage play. He interacts with another child in a green caterpillar costume. (9) The boy, now in a black graduation gown, kneels on the stage in front of a woman in a grey dress. The woman is visibly emotional, wiping tears from her eyes as she looks at him. (10) The boy stands proudly on stage holding a graduation certificate. He is flanked by other children and the emotional woman, who is now clapping. (11) The final scene shows the group of children on stage, waving their glowing star wands and singing together as the performance concludes.

It uses a montage of chronological clips—from his birth and infancy to shy early stage performances and finally his confident graduation day—to highlight his physical and emotional growth, effectively creating a touching narrative of parental pride.
